title: Vilvah in the UK: the brand, goat milk care and where to start
body:
Quick answer: Vilvah is an Indian natural beauty brand known for goat milk and botanical formulas for face, hair and body. The products most people start with are the Milk Drops serum and the Goat Milk Shampoo. Swansura is an official UK partner of Vilvah, so you can buy the range from UK stock, with free UK delivery over £40.

What is Vilvah known for?

Goat milk runs through the range, alongside plant extracts, hydrosols and short ingredient lists. Every Vilvah product page on our site shows the full ingredient list, so you can see exactly what you are buying.

Goat milk or plant milk? It depends on the product

Many Vilvah products have milk in the name, but not all of them contain goat milk. From each ingredient list:

  • Goat milk: Goat Milk Shampoo, Goat Milk Hair Mask, Goat Milk Body Wash and the goat milk soap bars, such as Classic Goatmilk Soap.
  • Rice milk extract: Milk Drops serum and the Milk Face Toner.
  • Oat milk: Milk Mud Mask and Milk Body Lotion.
  • Soy milk extract: Milk Lip Balm SPF 30 PA+++.

So if you avoid animal ingredients, the goat milk products are not for you, but several of the milk products are plant-based. Our goat milk soap guide explains the soap bars in detail.

Where to start with Vilvah

Face

  • Fragrance-Free Cream Face Wash (£9.99): a creamy wash with banana fruit extract and no added fragrance.
  • Honey Face Wash (£12.99): a gel wash with raw honey and papaya and blackberry extracts.
  • Milk Drops serum (from £21.99): a light gel serum with hyaluronic acid and rice milk extract. Our Vilvah Milk Drops guide covers the ingredients and the 20ml vs 40ml sizes.
  • Ultra Moisturising Cream (£25.99): olive squalane with bamboo and goji berry extracts.
  • Skin Finish Sunscreen SPF 50 PA+++ (£17.99): a daily face sunscreen with ceramides and niacinamide.

Hair

The Goat Milk Shampoo 250ML (£15.99) and Cream Conditioner 250ML (£15.99) are the classic pair, sold together as the Bestseller Hair Kit (£25.99). For dry, frizzy lengths, add the Goat Milk Hair Mask (£31.99) or the Anti-Frizz Hair Serum (£28.99), an oil serum with black seed, curry leaf and hibiscus oils and no silicones in its list. See our natural shampoo guide and frizzy hair guide.

Body

Goat Milk Body Wash (£15.99) uses goat milk and coconut oil in a chamomile water base; follow it with Milk Body Lotion (£25.99), made with oat milk and ceramide. The Deo Shot Kit (£17.99) holds two solid balm deodorants made without aluminium. Our body wash and bath bar guide and foot cream guide cover more of the range.

Lips

Milk Lip Balm SPF 30 PA+++ (£9.99) uses mineral filters for daytime; Vilvah also makes tinted lip balms. Compare them in our lip balm guide.

Is Vilvah a good brand?

We sell it, so here are the facts rather than a verdict. Vilvah publishes full ingredient lists, uses goat milk and plant extracts throughout, and keeps several lists very short; its rose water toner is only steam-distilled rose water. It does not suit everyone: the goat milk products are not vegan, some products contain essential oils or added fragrance, and the shampoos use a mild sulfosuccinate cleanser, so we do not call them sulphate-free. Patch test anything new, and if you have a skin condition, ask a pharmacist or GP first. Real customer reviews appear on each product page; we do not publish invented ones.

Buying Vilvah in the UK

  • Genuine stock: Swansura is an official UK partner of Vilvah.
  • Ships from the UK: no overseas wait and no import charge on delivery.
  • Delivery: free UK delivery over £40, and £5 off orders over £70 with code SAVE5.
  • Returns: unopened items within 14 days of delivery.

Vilvah or Deyga?

Deyga is the other Indian natural brand we stock as an official UK partner. Read Deyga Organics in the UK, compare the two in Deyga or Vilvah, or start with our Indian skincare in the UK guide. Shop all Vilvah or the wider natural skincare range.
summary: Vilvah explained for UK shoppers: what the brand makes, which products use goat milk and which use plant milks, where to start for face, hair and body, and how to buy Vilvah in the UK.
